name: UE3D Monitor Mode (Evil___Kermit fork)
description: A modified fork of UEVR, VRto3D, and 3DGameBridge by Evil___Kermit that adds native SR/Leia display support with head-tracked window projection (Kooima generalized perspective). Adds motion parallax, Z stereo depth scaling, Z FOV modulation, and per-eye off-axis frustum shifts for tracked 3D displays.
summary: UEVR fork + VRto3D + 3DGameBridge for SR/Leia displays

platform.note: Requires SteamVR, VRto3D driver, and 3DGameBridge ReShade addon — all from the Evil___Kermit forks.

uevr_fork.note: Replace UEVRBackend.dll and openvr_api.dll in your UEVR install.

vrto3d_fork.note: Extract drivers folder into Steam/config/ and register with SteamVR.

3dgamebridge_fork.note: 64-bit only. Place srReshade.addon64 in game folder alongside ReShade. Requires Leia SR Runtime.

requirements: UEVR v2.2 (evilkermitreturns fork — all three forks must match)
Leia SR Runtime (for eye tracking on SR displays)
notes: Pre-release. All three forks (UEVR, VRto3D, 3DGameBridge) must be from Evil___Kermit's repo as they communicate via shared memory (UE3D_SharedData protocol). The mainline UEVR, VRto3D, and 3DGameBridge builds are incompatible. Back up existing installs before replacing. The pipeline creator (oneup03) and Evil___Kermit are working toward merging these changes into mainline; use the standard UEVR pipeline until that happens unless you specifically need SR Leia head-tracking. Does not require VR headset for monitor output — SR display + SR Runtime only.
merge_status: Pre-release. Planned for mainline UEVR/VRto3D merge when stable.
